title: Administration and Research Building, Yad Vashem
axis: Native +X east and +Z south. The group of four tall windows faces north across the archives access lane.
identityStatus: The two retained PMTiles fragments of OSM way 245189822 define the detached east-west footprint around native feature 35184617278654.
